news.title: Second-Quarter Earnings Date Set
news.text: Exelixis announced it would release Q2 2025 financial results after market close on July 28.

news.title: Q2 2025 Results and Guidance Update
news.text: Exelixis reported $568.3 million in Q2 revenue and non-GAAP EPS of $0.75, beating earnings expectations while reiterating full-year guidance.

news.title: Positive Momentum from Analyst Commentary
news.text: Shares of Exelixis gained after favorable analyst commentary highlighted continued Cabozantinib strength.

news.title: Intrinsic Value Analysis Highlights Upside
news.text: Simply Wall St argued Exelixis could be undervalued by 51% based on discounted cash flow analysis, underscoring long-term potential.

news.title: Wells Fargo Healthcare Conference Appearance
news.text: Management participated in fireside chats at Wells Fargo's conference, emphasizing commercialization execution for CABOMETYX.

news.title: Morgan Stanley Healthcare Conference Presentation
news.text: Executives spotlighted CABOMETYX performance and pipeline progress during the Morgan Stanley Global Healthcare Conference.

news.title: H.C. Wainwright Global Investment Conference Participation
news.text: Exelixis outlined growth priorities at the H.C. Wainwright conference, reinforcing confidence in its oncology portfolio.

news.title: Bernstein Healthcare Forum Engagement
news.text: Company leadership met investors at Bernstein's Healthcare Forum to discuss long-term strategy and capital deployment.

news.title: Q3 2025 Earnings Release Scheduled
news.text: Exelixis announced it would report third-quarter 2025 results on November 6 after market close.

news.title: Expectations Build Ahead of Q3 Earnings
news.text: Financial press previewed Exelixis' Q3 report, citing anticipated growth in earnings and revenue driven by CABOMETYX sales.

news.title: Zanzalintinib Shows Encouraging Early Data
news.text: Exelixis reported promising Phase 1/2 results for oral Zanzalintinib in advanced solid tumors, drawing positive analyst commentary.
